_README: Copy this file to automation/config.json (which is gitignored) and fill in your keys. NEVER commit real keys. Env vars override these: LLM_BASE_URL, LLM_MODEL, DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, BRAVE_API_KEY.

local.note: Free LM Studio. Last in line now: the offline fallback when no cloud key answers.

brave.note: Brave Search API — used server-side only for research, never in the browser.

youtube.note: Set handle OR channelId (no API key needed — uses the public RSS feed). shortsPlaylistId is optional; videos in it render in the Shorts rail. import-youtube.mjs pulls your uploads into videos.json automatically.

gemini.note: Key comes from the GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable; leave apiKey empty here. Cents per twenty-minute episode.
